list.name: constraint_group
list.label: Constraint group
list.query: SELECT label AS __text, cg AS __value FROM (VALUES (1,'ERROEX','ERROEX'),(2,'B2 — SSEN-S','SSEN-S'),(3,'B4 — SSE-SP2','SSE-SP2'),(4,'B5 — NKILGRMO','NKILGRMO'),(5,'GALLEX','GALLEX'),(6,'B6 — SCOTEX','SCOTEX'),(7,'SSE-SP','SSE-SP'),(8,'FLOWSTH','FLOWSTH'),(9,'HARSPNBLY','HARSPNBLY'),(10,'B7 — SSHARN','SSHARN'),(11,'B7 — SSHARN3','SSHARN3'),(12,'SSHARN7','SSHARN7'),(13,'SHARN','SHARN'),(14,'SPANOREX','SPANOREX'),(15,'GM+SNOW5A','GM+SNOW5A'),(16,'GETEX','GETEX'),(17,'BRASIZEX','BRASIZEX'),(18,'SW1 — SWALEX','SWALEX'),(19,'SEIMP','SEIMP'),(20,'LE1 — SEIMPPR21','SEIMPPR21'),(21,'LE1 — SEIMPPR23','SEIMPPR23'),(22,'LE1 — SEIMPPR33','SEIMPPR33'),(23,'B15 — ESTEX','ESTEX')) AS t(ord,label,cg) WHERE cg IN (SELECT DISTINCT constraint_group FROM constraints WHERE ts BETWEEN to_timestamp($__from::bigint/1000) AND to_timestamp($__to::bigint/1000)) ORDER BY ord

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, 'Flow' AS metric, flow_mw AS value FROM constraints WHERE constraint_group IN (${constraint_group:singlequote}) AND ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY time

SELECT ts AS time, '24h Avg' AS metric, AVG(flow_mw) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 47 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS value FROM constraints WHERE constraint_group IN (${constraint_group:singlequote}) AND ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY time

SELECT ts AS time, 'Daily Max' AS metric, MAX(flow_mw) OVER (PARTITION BY date_trunc('day', ts)) AS value FROM constraints WHERE constraint_group IN (${constraint_group:singlequote}) AND ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY time

SELECT ts AS time, 'Daily Min' AS metric, MIN(flow_mw) OVER (PARTITION BY date_trunc('day', ts)) AS value FROM constraints WHERE constraint_group IN (${constraint_group:singlequote}) AND ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY time
SELECT ts AS time, 'Limit' AS metric, limit_mw AS value FROM constraints WHERE constraint_group IN (${constraint_group:singlequote}) AND ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY time
